setup: Convention ("(b) deep-only", rerun 2026-11-13): pixels with GEBCO depth < 10 m (shared constant experiments/depth_cutoff.py) are excluded from BOTH the inside and the outside group of every comparison. inside = class 1 of the month-year zone map (always deep); outside = deep (>= 10 m) pixels of that map that are not in the class.

sigma_share.note: sd uses ddof=1 here (pandas default, as in the old notebook); redo/sigma.py uses ddof=0, which changes the redo % by < 0.01 pp at ~40k pixels per map.

changes: - Unchanged (identical to the previous run): kmeans_sq_sep_share_pct, kmeans_raw_variance_share_pct. The -1 sigma class already used deep pixels only, so its inside medians are unchanged; the IF class now has its gates computed over deep pixels, so IF zones, Table 2, areas and IF inside medians change (see Sec. 6).
- **Outside** medians change because < 10 m water (higher a_CDOM and Chl, lower slopes) leaves the outside group. Largest relative changes of an outside median:
- Sign changes of an inside-minus-outside median difference: none.

- Rows whose 95% CI of the median difference excludes 0 under one convention but not the other: iforest_pooled a412 Feb: prev (a) [-0.01129, -0.0006242] -> deep-only [-0.008944, +0.001586], iforest_pooled a412 Mar: prev (a) [-0.0003769, +0.06272] -> deep-only [+0.001197, +0.06493], iforest_pooled s275 Feb: prev (a) [+0.0001216, +0.002523] -> deep-only [-0.0004178, +0.002125], iforest_pooled s300 Feb: prev (a) [+9.403e-05, +0.0009296] -> deep-only [-9.447e-05, +0.0007961], iforest_pooled log10_chl Feb: prev (a) [-0.1463, -0.01764] -> deep-only [-0.1195, +0.008495].

- Correlations: inside r unchanged; outside r (prev (a) -> deep-only): iforest May-Sep (Fig 18): Spearman out 0.977 -> 0.973, Pearson log10 out 0.976 -> 0.970; iforest all months (Fig 20): Spearman out 0.983 -> 0.980, Pearson log10 out 0.974 -> 0.970; iforest Oct-Apr (Fig 19): Spearman out 0.985 -> 0.983, Pearson log10 out 0.972 -> 0.968; iforest May 2018 (Fig 17): Spearman out 0.973 -> 0.967, Pearson log10 out 0.975 -> 0.965; sigma all months (Fig 20): Spearman out 0.980 -> 0.975, Pearson log10 out 0.974 -> 0.965; sigma May-Sep (Fig 18): Spearman out 0.966 -> 0.959, Pearson log10 out 0.976 -> 0.961.
- -1 sigma share: the number to quote is now the deep-pixel one: weekly rule 12.21% (was quoted as 13.21% without depth mask), monthly rule 12.87% (unchanged).

- -1 sigma figures (Fig. 7, 12, S2-S5) previously used the no-depth monthly rule (whole-grid threshold, `<=`). They now use the deep monthly rule, so for -1 sigma the **inside** group of the figures changes too; the "old fig rule" columns in Sec. 2 show the old figure numbers.
